title: Purification
summary: Purification rites addressed ceremonial uncleanness and restored people to worship and community life under the law.
background: Purification language appears around childbirth, disease, death, temple life, and worship readiness. The New Testament deepens the theme through cleansing in Christ.
teachingHelp: When teaching purification, explain the covenant setting first, then show how cleansing language points toward the deeper need for heart and conscience cleansing.
